description: This file contains unit tests for the ClaimDao class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing methods related to ClaimRequest objects within the Claim module. It includes setup code to initialize test fixtures and two test methods that verify claim request retrieval by ID and list filtering functionality.

classes.name: ClaimDaoRequestTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class testing methods of the ClaimDao class related to ClaimRequest retrieval within the HRM plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by instantiating ClaimDao and loading test data from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testGetClaimRequestById
methods.description: Tests that the ClaimDao correctly retrieves a ClaimRequest with ID 1.

methods.name: testGetClaimRequestList
methods.description: Tests that the ClaimDao correctly retrieves a list of ClaimRequest objects filtered by employee numbers.
